title: Among all cards that are legal in the 'commander' format and available in p
question: Among all cards that are legal in the 'commander' format and available in paper, what percentage have alternative language translations in Japanese and do not carry a content warning?

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."XCL_063" IN (SELECT "XCL_093" FROM set_translations WHERE "XCL_092" = 'Japanese') AND T1."XCL_064" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."XCL_001")
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_004" LIKE '%paper%'

INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND T1."XCL_004" LIKE '%paper%'
